posts.title: autistic burnout
posts.description: For me, the venn diagram of autistic burnout and creative burnout has a lot of overlap between the component circles, but there are a few things that distinguish them from one another. posts.title: im gonna fight the tech industry for ruining robots
posts.description: I think I'm probably gonna go to the grave bitter than tech bros and the billionaire class are starting to make me hate robots. Robots (in fiction) have been my beloved little guys, my conduit, my fascination for a long, long time. I've always enjoyed stories with robots at the center, where robots are a part of the worldbulding and cast; there are so many interesting concepts to explore with them
